compositions.label: Customer and member portals
compositions.founder_problem: Give customers one place to sign in, see access, and manage their account.
compositions.supported_job: Provide identity, sign-in, account view, and access-record surfaces for a product.
compositions.claim: Can cover the account and access job through a composed portal surface.

integration_requirements.requirement: Account identity/session and product-access owner targets must be configured.

cost.basis: The current Store rows are marked Free; composition total is not a package-set price.

time.basis: No verified implementation-time measure exists in the package evidence.

compounding_value.rationale: One generic access boundary can be reused by multiple product surfaces without re-owning identity or billing logic.

gaps: No verified CRM, support inbox, or community package in the current Store snapshot.
No claim of replacing a complete customer platform.
migration_path: Map the current account and access job.
Select the identity/session/access package records.
Configure owner targets and destination surface.
Verify the account and access evidence before migration.

compositions.label: Billing and access
compositions.founder_problem: Turn a paid product into a clear path from checkout to usable access.
compositions.supported_job: Run checkout decisions, route an external payment operation, show pricing, activate a device, and project product access.
compositions.claim: Can cover a paid checkout-to-access path when the required provider and account records exist.

integration_requirements.requirement: A configured payment provider connection and credential owner are required.
Checkout, activation, and product-access targets must be admitted for the product.

cost.basis: Current Store rows are marked Free; external provider fees and activation plan values are destination data, not Store estimates.
cost.source: catalog row price blocks and payment-adapter contract

compounding_value.rationale: Payment, activation, and access remain replaceable owner lanes instead of being absorbed into a product surface.

gaps: Provider setup, tax, fraud, and real payment round-trip still require destination evidence.
No blanket replacement claim for Stripe Billing or a merchant-of-record.
migration_path: Name the exact checkout and access boundary.
Map provider and credential requirements.
Compose checkout, payment, activation, and access records.
Replay free and paid evidence before switching traffic.

compositions.label: Workflow automation
compositions.founder_problem: Connect declared actions, current records, and outside services without hiding the workflow in a proprietary scenario.
compositions.supported_job: Execute a declared workflow over current records and configured HTTP/process boundaries.
compositions.claim: Can cover workflow execution and service-call orchestration for the configured boundaries.

integration_requirements.requirement: Each outside destination needs a configured service connection and credential resolver.
The workflow definition and target addresses must be admitted as data.

cost.basis: Current Store rows are marked Free; outside service fees, provider plans, and local compute are not included.

compounding_value.rationale: A single workflow engine can execute new declared jobs without a new UI branch, while destination connections remain data.

gaps: The current Store snapshot does not prove a broad connector catalog.
No claim that all Zapier, n8n, Make, or Lindy integrations are present.
AI guidance is not shown because no evidence-aware AI action is configured on this surface.
migration_path: Inventory the source and destination jobs.
Declare the workflow steps and service connections.
Replay current-record and external-call receipts.
Move one bounded job before migrating the wider automation set.

compositions.label: Website and product surfaces
compositions.founder_problem: Shape a founder-facing website or product surface without buying a fixed page-builder runtime.
compositions.supported_job: Compose a browser surface from UI, layout, look, page registry, and a guarded hosted build/deploy path.
compositions.claim: Can cover a configured product surface and hosted projection path.

integration_requirements.requirement: A configured build/deploy process and destination are required.
The page surface, layout, look, and registry records must be available to the browser shell.

cost.basis: The current Store rows are mostly Free; screen-arrangement is marked Buy to install; hosting/provider costs are not estimated.

compounding_value.rationale: The shell and deploy path stay generic while new product surfaces arrive as records and package material.

gaps: No verified general page-builder editor or CMS in the current Store snapshot.
No claim of replacing Webflow, Framer, or Figma as a design editor.
migration_path: Define the surface job and destination.
Map page, layout, look, and UI package material.
Build and inspect the guarded hosted projection.
Migrate one public surface before replacing a broader site stack.

compositions.label: Visual canvas composition
compositions.founder_problem: Render a structured graph or composition surface with state kept outside the renderer.
compositions.supported_job: Render a generic graph/canvas surface backed by the composition engine and externalized state.
compositions.claim: Can cover the rendering job for a configured graph or composition surface.

integration_requirements.requirement: A configured composition state source and surface mount are required.

cost.basis: Current Store rows are marked Free; no collaboration or design-service costs are estimated.

compounding_value.rationale: The renderer and composition kernel can support different surface data without embedding a product's collaboration vocabulary.

gaps: Collaboration, presence, comments, and design-file interoperability are not proven in the current Store snapshot.
This is a rendering composition, not a replacement for Figma, Miro, or Excalidraw.
migration_path: Separate the rendering job from collaboration requirements.
Map the graph or composition state.
Mount the generic renderer.
Request the missing collaboration primitives rather than implying they already exist.

compositions.label: Publish and package operations
compositions.founder_problem: Publish, list, move, and install package files without making one product package own the whole distribution system.
compositions.supported_job: Publish package material, derive a signed catalog row, and install admitted package files through access and trust proofs.
compositions.claim: Can cover the package distribution job for the configured Package Store flow.

integration_requirements.requirement: Signed package-use proof, publisher trust root, and access evidence must be present.
Runtime Kit package-files destination must be configured.

cost.basis: Current Store rows are marked Free; paid access remains owned by Account Portal/checkout lanes.

compounding_value.rationale: The same admission and install primitives can carry future package sets without a new Store installer.

gaps: Publish and install round trips remain destination verification work.
No claim of replacing a general app marketplace or package ecosystem.
migration_path: Describe the package material and access boundary.
Publish package finding facts through the owner action.
Verify admission and install evidence.
Move the package set through the canonical file destination.

compositions.label: Product discovery and distribution
compositions.founder_problem: Help people find a product, understand it, and carry it into the surface where it belongs.
compositions.supported_job: Browse package and product records, hand off public actions, carry open-record surfaces, and publish a hosted projection.
compositions.claim: Can cover the public discovery-to-entry path for configured product records.

integration_requirements.requirement: Current package finding records and discovery records must be projected.
Public entry and hosting owner targets must be configured.

cost.basis: Current Store rows are marked Free; hosting and acquisition costs are not estimated.

compounding_value.rationale: One public entry primitive can hand off arbitrary declared actions without product-specific branches.

gaps: No verified ad, CRM, or product-analytics package in the current Store snapshot.
No claim of replacing a full acquisition stack.
migration_path: Name the public discovery and entry job.
Project the catalog and product records.
Configure availability-gated owner actions.
Verify hosted delivery and public entry evidence.
